name: GOES-19 motion-estimator benchmark
description: Code and per-day results of a controlled benchmark of eleven motion estimators for extrapolation nowcasting of GOES-19 ABI band-13 (10.3 µm) brightness temperature over a 192 x 192-pixel domain off southern Brazil: persistence, phase correlation, Farnebäck, DIS, TV-L1 and six deep models used zero-shot (SEA-RAFT, DPFlow, WAFT, MEMFOF, TAPNext, CoTracker3). All methods drive the same backward-advection operator; 30 test days (339 one-hour and 160 two-hour windows) with paired day-level bootstrap inference. Contents: GOES-19 ABI-L2-CMIPF reader (HDF5 range reads of the public NOAA bucket), benchmark code, configuration, unit tests, scripts that regenerate the figures and tables of the paper, and the result files (per-window, per-day and aggregate metrics, paired statistics, rankings, timing). Not included: satellite data (public, downloaded by scripts/download_data.sh), stored forecasts, and third-party code and weights, which keep their own licences (see third_party/README.md; CoTracker3 weights are non-commercial).
